name: the reconnect boundary is marked when the socket drops, before the new connection subscribes
replace:
/\ status' = "dormant"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<head, applied, mode, snap, run, pullPending, terminal, snaps, losses>>

/\ status' = "dormant"
  /\ EnterResync
  /\ UNCHANGED <<head, applied, pullPending, terminal, snaps, losses>>

/\ conn' = "up" /\ status' = "ready"
  /\ EnterResync
  /\ UNCHANGED <<head, applied, wire, pullPending, terminal, snaps, drops, losses>>

/\ conn' = "up" /\ status' = "ready"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<head, applied, wire, mode, snap, run, pullPending, terminal, snaps, drops, losses>>

name: a delta past the held end is appended to the run as if contiguous
replace:
m.since > HeldEnd
          /\ mode' = "holding" /\ snap' = snap /\ run' = run \cup {m.to}

name: the tracker reconnects after a terminal outcome, and ready replaces it
resync drops the held messages without a fresh pull
